description: This file implements MD5 hashing functions, including initialization, transformation, update, and finalization routines, along with internal MD5 block processing. It is part of the BoringSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: MD5
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of input data, returning the digest.

methods.name: MD5_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD5 context with standard initial values.

methods.name: MD5_Update
methods.description: Updates MD5 context with additional data.

methods.name: MD5_Final
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 hash computation and outputs the digest.

methods.name: MD5_Transform
methods.description: Performs MD5 transformation on a single block.
